description: ubq_dna (ubiquitin next to a 12-bp DNA duplex) with two amino acids moved inside the protein-DNA excluded-volume walls (tools/make_ubq_dna_wall.py): amino acid 31 in the quartic part of the backbone wall of nucleotide 98, amino acid 32 in the Lennard-Jones part of the base wall of nucleotide 97. Checks the strength of these walls (1 on the CPU; master's CUDA DNANM used 2, oxDNA PR #240): the CUDA energy0 check compares the GPU and host energies, which a factor 2 would change by 9e-3 per particle, and the nve check needs consistent forces.

DNANM.description: protein + DNA with amino acids inside the protein-DNA walls: DNANM

DNACT.description: protein + DNA with amino acids inside the protein-DNA walls: DNACT
